name: fiefdom
description: An isometric castle-builder in the spirit of Stronghold Crusader, played in the browser. Build a settlement in the desert, run the food, ale and weapon chains, raise a garrison and hold your ground against an enemy lord who builds his own economy under the same rules you do. ⚙ Nothing to configure: no database, no API keys, no accounts. Set the port, start it, open the WebUI. ⚠ Saved games live in YOUR BROWSER (localStorage), not on the server. They do not follow you between devices or browsers, and clearing site data removes them. Runs entirely client-side: the container only serves static files, so it uses almost no CPU or memory on the server. A WebGL-capable browser is required.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port the game is reached on.
